description.value: Family-owned whale and wildlife watching company operating out of Victoria's Inner Harbour for over 33 years. Tours head into the Salish Sea to see orcas, humpbacks, sea lions, and eagles aboard either a comfortable ocean cruiser or high-speed zodiacs. They run a 95%+ whale sighting success rate with a come-back-free guarantee if no whales are spotted.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 70m; stands (6 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 79m; stands (6 spaces) at 84m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms SpringTide is an active, family-owned whale watching company operating from 1119 Wharf Street in Victoria for over 33 years, matching the OSM address. The FAQ mentions bathrooms are available on the boat (truncated text: 'Bathrooms are only av...'), and complimentary beverages are served on Ocean Cruiser tours, but neither washrooms nor water refill are confirmed at the dockside check-in location. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name uses camelCase 'SpringTide' while website uses 'Springtide' as one word — minor discrepancy, kept OSM spelling per rules
No phone number available in OSM or extracted website content
Food and beverages are onboard the tour boats, not at a dockside cafe — cyclist would need to be a tour customer to access
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Popular, long-established whale watching attraction on Victoria's Inner Harbour waterfront, directly along common cycling routes. A compelling activity for touring cyclists visiting Victoria.

Café or food on site.detail: Complimentary hot chocolate, coffee, and tea on Ocean Cruiser tours; granola bars and protein bars available for cash purchase onboard
